sentences.text: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System , after Mercury .	Sun	Sun	planet	planet	Solar System	Solar System	Mercury	Mercury (planet)

Named after the Roman god of war , it is often referred to as the `` Red Planet '' because the iron oxide prevalent on its surface gives it a reddish appearance .	Roman god of war	Mars (mythology)	iron oxide	iron(III) oxide	reddish appearance	Mars surface color

Mars is a terrestrial planet with a thin atmosphere , having surface features reminiscent both of the impact craters of the Moon and the valleys , deserts , and polar ice caps of Earth .	planet	planet	terrestrial planet	terrestrial planet	atmosphere	atmosphere	Moon	Moon	polar ice caps	polar ice caps	Earth	Earth
The rotational period and seasonal cycles of Mars are likewise similar to those of Earth , as is the tilt that produces the seasons .	Earth	Earth	rotational period	rotational period

Mars is the site of Olympus Mons , the largest volcano and second-highest known mountain in the Solar System , and of Valles Marineris , one of the largest canyons in the Solar System .	Solar System	Solar System	Olympus Mons	Olympus Mons	volcano	volcano	second-highest known mountain in the Solar System	List of tallest mountains in the Solar System	Valles Marineris	Valles Marineris
The smooth Borealis basin in the northern hemisphere covers 40 % of the planet and may be a giant impact feature .	planet	planet	Borealis basin	Borealis basin
Mars has two moons , Phobos and Deimos , which are small and irregularly shaped .	moons	Moons of Mars	Phobos	Phobos (moon)	Deimos	Deimos (moon)
These may be captured asteroids , similar to 5261 Eureka , a Mars trojan .	5261 Eureka	5261 Eureka	Mars trojan	Mars trojan

There are ongoing investigations assessing the past habitability potential of Mars , as well as the possibility of extant life .	habitability	planetary habitability	the possibility of extant life	Life on Mars
Future astrobiology missions are planned , including the Mars 2020 and ExoMars rovers .	Mars 2020	Mars 2020	ExoMars	ExoMars rover

Liquid water can not exist on the surface of Mars due to low atmospheric pressure , which is about that of the Earth 's , except at the lowest elevations for short periods .	Earth	Earth	water	Water on Mars
The two polar ice caps appear to be made largely of water .	polar ice caps	polar ice caps	water	Water on Mars
The volume of water ice in the south polar ice cap , if melted , would be sufficient to cover the entire planetary surface to a depth of 11 m .	water	Water on Mars
In November 2016 , NASA reported finding a large amount of underground ice in the Utopia Planitia region of Mars .	underground ice	Water on Mars	Utopia Planitia	Utopia Planitia
The volume of water detected has been estimated to be equivalent to the volume of water in Lake Superior .	water	Water on Mars	Lake Superior	Lake Superior
Mars can easily be seen from Earth with the naked eye , as can its reddish coloring .	Earth	Earth

Its apparent magnitude reaches − 2.91 , which is surpassed only by Jupiter , Venus , the Moon , and the Sun .	Sun	Sun	2	Moons of Mars	Moon	Moon	apparent magnitude	apparent magnitude	Jupiter	Jupiter	Venus	Venus
Optical ground-based telescopes are typically limited to resolving features about 300 km across when Earth and Mars are closest because of Earth 's atmosphere .	atmosphere	atmosphere	Earth	Earth
